source.label: Huan Huang and Natalie Baddour, University of Ottawa
source.description: Measured inner-race bearing run-up, recording I-A-1. The original 200 kHz accelerometer excerpt covers 3.50–6.06 seconds in published channel units.

processing.resampling: Full recording resampled 1:16 with a centered Kaiser FIR (beta 5), then excerpted.
processing.normalization: Subtract the excerpt mean and divide by the excerpt RMS.
processing.wavelet: Complex Morlet with omega0 = 6, DC correction, and a discrete unit-energy kernel.
processing.edgeTreatment: Linear convolution with zeroes outside the excerpt, kernel truncated at ±8 scale radii.
processing.timeBinAggregation: Maximum of the squared coefficient magnitudes within each time bin.
processing.powerReference: 10 log10(power / peak retained power), clipped at -60 dB.
processing.powerEncoding: Unsigned 8-bit samples, rows in ascending frequency order, time fastest.
processing.waveformEncoding: Little-endian signed int16 samples, in time order.
processing.originalWaveformEncoding: Gzip stream containing a uint32 little-endian dictionary length, a float64 little-endian dictionary, then the low and high byte planes of uint16 sample indices.
